description: Single Source of Truth (SSOT) for OpenCode plugin pins. Every entry mirrors one plugin of the live config (~/.config/opencode/opencode.json plugin array); versions of entries the live config leaves floating were resolved from the npm registry on 2026-10-16. Rule: no plugin is installed from a floating tag - bump the pin here first, then regenerate opencode.json. See src/data/README.md.

v2.note: Verified by actual load on 2.1.4 (2026-10-26). V1-only plugins fail with 'Plugin must export a default definition with an id and an effect or setup function'.

channel_notes.v1: OpenCode 1.19.x is the latest dist-tag on npm (opencode-ai) and still ships patches. All community plugins below are loadable here; this is the channel every machine runs.
channel_notes.v2: OpenCode 2.0.27 exists only under beta/next/dev snapshot tags, not as a published 2.x release. It cannot load V1 community plugins, so the V2 channel is parked: do not install the v2 entries on a v1 binary.

criticality: critical=true marks a plugin whose absence degrades the harness itself (code intelligence, orchestration, context management, goal protocol). critical=false plugins are feature add-ons: their absence is a feature loss, not a harness break.
